mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) during a monetary tightening cycle compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of instances during tightening cycles, or the 20d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 8.5% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the subsequent 20 trading days as market anticipates labor market stabilization.
failure_condition: SPX returns not positive in >60% of UNRATE crossings above 8.5%, or p-value exceeds 0.05 in a t-test.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both GDPC1 (total personal consumption expenditures) and RSAFS (durable goods orders) signals robust demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and RSAFS both rise but SPX returns not positive in >60% of instances, or IC < 0.03 over a 3-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained Federal Funds Rate above 4.5% predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to elevated borrowing costs.
failure_condition: SPX returns not negative in >60% of tightening periods with FEDFUNDS >4.5%, or IC > 0.05 over a 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rapid job growth indicated by rising PAYEMS (employment) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days as markets anticipate economic resilience.
failure_condition: PAYEMS rises but SPX returns not positive in >60% of instances, or p-value exceeds 0.05 in a t-test.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO (supplies index) above 98.5 triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as market anticipates supply-side expansion.
failure_condition: INDPRO crosses above 98.5 but SPX returns not positive in >60% of cases, or IC < 0.03 over a 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both GDPC1 (personal consumption) and HOUST (industrial production) signals robust demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and HOUST rise but SPX returns not positive in >60% of instances, or IC < 0.03 over a 3-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in CPIAUCSL (inflation) below 2% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as markets anticipate reduced inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL drops below 2% in late-cycle but SPX returns not positive in >60% of instances, or IC > 0.05 over a 1-year window.
